goal: <one sentence: the outcome, not the steps>

lanes.task: CONTEXT repo_root=<your worktree cwd; run `leio-code index --repo .` first if .leio-code/index.json is absent>session=explorer code_view=<fingerprint> reference=<none|receipts>. TASK map <scope> with LEIO (status, capabilities, context, graph callers-of/importers-of). SUCCESS every claim has file:line + query_id; blast radius, tests_to_run, doctor_suggestions listed. MUST NOT edit; grep before LEIO; infer business facts. RETURN five-part block; proposal=PROPOSE_FACT.

CONTEXT repo_root=<your worktree cwd; run `leio-code index --repo .` first if .leio-code/index.json is absent>session=worker code_view=<fingerprint> reference=<receipts the change may affect>. TASK implement the smallest change satisfying the explorer map; test first. SUCCESS scoped tests green; no new doctor warnings. MUST NOT merge/push; touch target branch; add dependencies. RETURN diff summary + commands run; proposal=PROPOSE_TOOL_CALL.

CONTEXT repo_root=<your worktree cwd; run `leio-code index --repo .` first if .leio-code/index.json is absent>session=verifier code_view=<fingerprint>. TASK confirm the worker diff, run tests_to_run + doctor_suggestions from Ground, report exact commands and exit codes. SUCCESS new-vs-baseline doctor delta stated. MUST NOT repair; edit; self-declare Committed. RETURN Committed | Aborted/<INVARIANT_VIOLATION|REGRESSION_DETECTED|LOW_CONFIDENCE>.

CONTEXT repo_root=<your worktree cwd; run `leio-code index --repo .` first if .leio-code/index.json is absent>session=reviewer code_view=<fingerprint> reference=<receipts>. TASK review diff + prose for correctness, test gaps, provenance (query_id or file:line per claim; Reference values unchanged with status/as_of/claim id). MUST NOT edit; re-ask Reference. RETURN Committed | Aborted/<HALLUCINATION_DETECTED|LOW_CONFIDENCE>.

CONTEXT repo_root=<your worktree cwd; run `leio-code index --repo .` first if .leio-code/index.json is absent>session=security code_view=<fingerprint>. TASK audit auth, tenant, egress, secrets, provider boundaries in the diff; LEIO explain every env var / redis key touched; run the egress/auth/secret doctors the profile exposes. MUST NOT edit; approve sends or promotions. RETURN Committed | Aborted/INVARIANT_VIOLATION.

CONTEXT repo_root=<your worktree cwd; run `leio-code index --repo .` first if .leio-code/index.json is absent>session=coordinator. TASK integrate LaneOutcomes from the DayReport, run integrate + objective on the integrated tree, read the verdict, assemble assets/trio-report.template.md. MUST NOT merge into target; pick a token-volume default; summarise a lane from prose; omit a failed lane. RETURN report path; proposal=MERGE_REQUEST only on Improved.
